column1: %1$s becomes the date and time of the save, %2$s the video's number on Instagram, %3$s who posted it and %4$s the day it was posted. What a save doesn't know is left out, and a name with none of these gets the date added. When the name is already in the folder, the time of the save goes on the end. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to use the default, %5$s.
column2: %1$s 代表保存的日期和时间，%2$s 代表视频在 Instagram 上的编号，%3$s 代表发布者，%4$s 代表发布日期。无法获取的信息会被省略；若名称中不含任何这些信息，则会加上日期。文件夹中已有同名文件时，会在末尾加上保存时间。无效字符会替换为下划线。留空则使用默认值 %5$s。

column1: A PIN you set here unlocks your messages, in place of your screen lock. It can't be recovered, only cleared by clearing Instagram's storage.
column2: 在此设置的 PIN 用于解锁私信，代替屏幕锁定。PIN 无法找回，只能通过清除 Instagram 的存储空间来移除。

column1: A carousel post's page sits a little in from the edges, with the start of the next page showing at the right.
column2: 轮播帖子的页面会稍微内缩于边缘，右侧露出下一页的开头。

column1: A chat you open stays unread in your messages on this phone until you long press it and tap Mark as read. A newer message in it stays unread too. Turned off, a chat you open stays read on this phone until a newer message comes in, even after your messages refresh.
column2: 在这部手机上，打开过的聊天会保持未读，直到你长按并点击「标记为已读」。其中新收到的消息也会保持未读。关闭后，打开过的聊天会保持已读，直到有新消息进来，即使私信刷新后也是如此。

column1: A check mark shows at the top of a chat while it hasn't told the other person you've seen it. Tap it and they see Seen.
column2: 在对方还不知道你已看过聊天时，聊天顶部会显示一个对勾。点击它，对方就会看到「已读」。

column1: A color as six hex digits, like #4A6B82. HushGram makes it darker or lighter where text needs it. Restart Instagram to see it.
column2: 用六位十六进制数字表示的颜色，例如 #4A6B82。HushGram 会在文字需要的地方把它调深或调浅。重启 Instagram 后即可看到。

column1: A diagnostic report is already being saved.
column2: 已有诊断报告正在保存。

column1: A double tap on a comment doesn't like it. Starts off, so comments keep double tap to like until you turn this on.
column2: 双击评论不会点赞。默认关闭，因此在你开启此选项前，评论保留双击点赞。

column1: A double tap on a message in a chat doesn't react to it. Starts off. A long press still shows the reactions.
column2: 双击聊天中的消息不会发送表情回应。默认关闭。长按仍会显示表情回应选项。

column1: A double tap on a post doesn't like it. Turn this off to keep double tap to like on posts.
column2: 双击帖子不会点赞。关闭此选项可保留帖子双击点赞。

column1: A double tap on a post or reel no longer likes it or shows a heart. A single tap and the Like button work as before.
column2: 双击帖子或 Reel 不再点赞或显示爱心。单击和点赞按钮照常工作。

column1: A double tap on a reel doesn't like it. Turn this off to keep double tap to like on reels.
column2: 双击 Reel 不会点赞。关闭此选项可保留 Reels 双击点赞。

column1: A double tap on the left side of a reel goes back 10 seconds, and on the right side it goes ahead 10 seconds. A double tap in the middle still likes it. Reels under 10 seconds don't skip.
column2: 在 Reel 左侧双击会倒退 10 秒，右侧双击会前进 10 秒。中间双击仍会点赞。不足 10 秒的 Reel 不会跳转。

column1: A fainter bar and handle, so more of the video shows through.
column2: 更淡的进度条和拖动柄，让更多视频画面透出来。

column1: A file named %1$s in %2$s paused HushGram.
column2: %2$s 中名为 %1$s 的文件使 HushGram 暂停。

column1: A finished story stays on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn this off for Instagram's timing.
column2: 快拍播放结束后会停留在画面上，直到你点击或滑动。关闭后使用 Instagram 原本的切换时间。

column1: A frosted glass pill that blurs the photo under it. Before Android 12 it's see-through instead.
column2: 毛玻璃胶囊，会模糊其下方的照片。Android 12 之前改为半透明。

column1: A group for each kind of notification, such as comments or messages, in place of one group.
column2: 按评论、私信等通知类型分别建组，而不是全部放在一个组里。

column1: A left swipe on a reel opens the creator's profile, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels.
column2: 在 Reel 上向左滑动会打开创作者的个人主页，就像 Instagram 以前那样。点击顶部的「好友」可查看好友的 Reels。

column1: A light pill with dark dots, as it's always been.
column2: 浅色胶囊配深色圆点，与以往相同。

column1: A light tick each time the highlight slides past a tab, so it follows the bar as you tap or swipe between screens.
column2: 点击或滑动切换页面时，高亮每滑过一个标签页就轻震一次，让触感反馈跟随标签栏。
稍多

column1: A long press on the Instagram logo at the top of Home opens these settings. Off, the long press goes back to Instagram.
column2: 长按首页顶部的 Instagram 标志即可打开这些设置。关闭后，长按恢复 Instagram 原本的操作。

column1: A long press on the menu button, the three lines at the top right of your own profile, opens HushGram. A tap still opens Instagram's menu, and other profiles stay the same.
column2: 长按自己个人主页右上角的三条线菜单按钮即可打开 HushGram。点击仍会打开 Instagram 菜单，其他人的个人主页不受影响。

column1: A reel Instagram's auto scroll moves to waits for your tap too. Off, auto scroll plays reel after reel.
column2: Instagram 自动滚动切换到的 Reel 也会等待你点击才播放。关闭时，自动滚动会连续播放 Reels。

column1: A reel that doesn't fill the screen shows a blurred copy of itself above and below it instead of black bars, and the strip under the tab bar and the band behind the clock show the reel blurred too. The copy shows only where a reel leaves room, as with Show the whole reel on. Open Reels again after a change.
column2: 未填满屏幕的 Reel 会在上下显示自身的模糊副本，取代黑边；标签栏下方和时钟背后的区域也会显示模糊的 Reel。模糊副本只出现在 Reel 留有空间的地方，例如开启「显示完整 Reel」时。更改后请重新打开 Reels。

column1: A reel you open from the Reels tab or a post on Home plays with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Your phone's ringer and volume still count.
column2: 从 Reels 标签页或首页帖子打开的 Reel 会有声播放，返回后首页恢复静音。手机的铃声模式和音量仍然有效。

column1: A save stopped. Reopen the media and save again.
column2: 一项保存已停止。请重新打开媒体后再次保存。
一项保存被中断

column1: A see-through dark pill with white dots, so more of the photo shows.
column2: 半透明深色胶囊配白色圆点，让更多照片透出来。

column1: A sideways swipe no longer moves you between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tap the tab bar instead. Stop swipe to create covers the camera.
column2: 左右滑动不再在首页、Reels 和其他主标签页之间切换，请改为点击标签栏。「停止滑动打开创作」覆盖相机。

column1: A sideways swipe on Home no longer opens the camera. The + button and every other way into the camera still work.
column2: 在首页左右滑动不再打开相机。+ 按钮和其他打开相机的方式仍然有效。

column1: A smaller chip, centered under the profile picture. A profile with no room there gets the small chip under the counts.
column2: 更小的徽章，居中放在头像下方。若那里没有空间，则改放在各项数量下方。

column1: A story keeps playing while you pinch to zoom it. Hold it still first and it stays paused while you zoom.
column2: 双指缩放快拍时会继续播放。若先按住不动，缩放时会保持暂停。

column1: A story plays again from the start when it ends, until you tap or swipe to move on. Ads still move on. With Stop Story auto-advance on too, stories loop.
column2: 快拍播放结束后会从头重播，直到你点击或滑动切换。广告仍会自动切换。同时开启「停止快拍自动切换」时，快拍会循环播放。

column1: A story you tap in the stories row opens with a slower zoom that doesn't bounce, and closes the same way.
column2: 在快拍横排中点击的快拍会以更慢、不回弹的缩放打开，关闭时也一样。

column1: A story's header says how many accounts it mentions, even when the mention is hidden. Tap that for the list, and tap someone to open their profile.
column2: 快拍顶部会显示提及的账号数量，即使提及被隐藏也适用。点击可查看名单，再点击账号即可打开其个人主页。

column1: A story's header shows its time the way the choice below says, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.
column2: 快拍顶部会按下方选项显示时间，取代「多久之前」的写法。遵循手机的语言和 12 或 24 小时制设置。

column1: A swipe in Reels no longer moves on to the next reel, and pulling down doesn't load new ones. The reel you opened still plays. Restart Instagram to see the change.
column2: 在 Reels 中滑动不再切换到下一条，下拉也不会加载新内容。已打开的 Reel 仍会播放。重启 Instagram 后生效。

column1: A swipe up on someone's story no longer opens the reply box and its reactions. Tap Send message to reply.
column2: 在他人快拍上向上滑动不再打开回复框和表情回应。请点击「发消息」回复。

column1: A tap on a playing reel does nothing, so a stray touch doesn't stop it. A reel that's paused still plays on a tap.
column2: 点击播放中的 Reel 没有任何反应，误触也不会让它停下。已暂停的 Reel 仍会在点击后播放。

column1: A tap on a playing reel turns its sound off or on and keeps it playing. A reel that's paused still plays on a tap.
column2: 点击播放中的 Reel 会切换静音并继续播放。已暂停的 Reel 仍会在点击后播放。
点击 Reel 的操作

column1: A tap on a reel does what Instagram does.
column2: 点击 Reel 时使用 Instagram 原本的操作。

column1: A tap on a reel pauses it, and another tap plays it again.
column2: 点击 Reel 即可暂停，再次点击继续播放。

column1: A tap on the download icon beside a reel lets you pick the reel, its cover or its sound, whichever it has.
column2: 点击 Reel 旁的下载图标，可按该 Reel 拥有的内容选择保存 Reel、封面或音频。

column1: A video or reel playing with sound keeps going when you leave Instagram or turn the screen off. A notification lets you pause or stop it.
column2: 有声播放的视频或 Reel 在你离开 Instagram 或关闭屏幕时会继续播放。通知可让你暂停或停止播放。

column1: A white bar and handle, as they've always been.
column2: 白色进度条和拖动柄，与以往相同。

column1: A white bar on a strip of frosted glass that blurs the video under it. Before Android 12 the strip is see-through instead.
column2: 白色进度条置于毛玻璃条上，会模糊其下方的视频。Android 12 之前此条改为半透明。

column1: Added %1$s. Pick it in the story text editor.
column2: 已添加 %1$s。可在快拍文字编辑器中选用。

column1: Adds Choose pages to a carousel's menu, after Save all, and to the download icon. Tick the pages you want and only those save, in order.
column2: 在轮播帖子菜单的「全部保存」之后和下载图标中新增「选择页面」。勾选想要的页面后，只会按顺序保存这些页面。

column1: Adds Copy to a selected comment's menu. Copies the original text, including line breaks.
column2: 在所选评论的菜单中新增「复制」。复制原始文字，保留换行。

column1: Adds Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. Each copies the text exactly as the account has it.
column2: 在他人个人主页的菜单中新增「复制用户名」和「复制个人简介」。按账号原文完整复制。

column1: Adds Copy username to a selected comment's menu, for the account that wrote it.
column2: 在所选评论的菜单中新增「复制用户名」，复制发表该评论的账号名称。

column1: Adds Details to a feed post's or reel's menu. It shows when it went up, who posted it, its media ID and the size Download saves, with buttons to copy the file link, username and caption.
column2: 在首页帖子或 Reel 的菜单中新增「详情」。显示发布时间、发布者、媒体 ID 和下载保存的尺寸，并提供复制文件链接、用户名和配文的按钮。

column1: Adds Download audio under Download. It saves the sound of the reel as an audio file.
column2: 在「下载」下方新增「下载音频」。把 Reel 的声音保存为音频文件。

column1: Adds Download cover to the menu of a feed post with a video, and of a carousel showing one. It saves the still picture shown before the video plays, at its largest size.
column2: 在首页视频帖子和当前显示视频的轮播帖子菜单中新增「下载封面」。以最大尺寸保存视频播放前显示的静态图片。

column1: Adds Download cover under Download. It saves the still picture a reel shows before it plays, at its largest size.
column2: 在「下载」下方新增「下载封面」。以最大尺寸保存 Reel 播放前显示的静态图片。

column1: Adds Download to every reel's more menu, saved at your download quality. Off or paused, Instagram's own menu returns.
column2: 在每条 Reel 的更多菜单中新增「下载」，按你的下载画质保存。关闭或暂停后，恢复 Instagram 原本的菜单。

column1: Adds Download to the menu of a post in your feed with a video. Uses the quality below. Off or paused, Instagram's own menu returns.
column2: 在首页视频帖子的菜单中新增「下载」。使用下方的画质设置。关闭或暂停后，恢复 Instagram 原本的菜单。

column1: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story, photo or video, saved at your download quality. Off or paused, Instagram's own menu returns.
column2: 在任何人快拍的菜单中新增「下载」，照片和视频都适用，按你的下载画质保存。关闭或暂停后，恢复 Instagram 原本的菜单。

column1: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any. Nothing shows until Instagram has checked.
column2: 在他人个人主页的名称旁新增「关注了你」或「未关注你」；若设置过代词，则显示在代词之后。Instagram 完成查询前不会显示。

column1: Adds Playback speed to the menu a reel's three dots open. Pick a speed there from 0.5x to 3x. With Keep the reel speed on, the next reels play at it too.
column2: 在 Reel 三个点打开的菜单中加入「播放速度」。可在那里选择 0.5x 到 3x 的速度。开启「保留 Reel 播放速度」时，之后的 Reels 也会以该速度播放。

column1: Adds Save profile picture to the menu on someone's profile. Saves their picture at the largest size Instagram has.
column2: 在他人个人主页的菜单中新增「保存头像」。以 Instagram 提供的最大尺寸保存。

column1: Adds Save to a selected comment's menu when the comment has its own photo or GIF. Saves the largest size Instagram sent.
column2: 若评论带有自己的照片或 GIF，则在所选评论的菜单中新增「保存」。以 Instagram 发送的最大尺寸保存。

column1: Adds Save to the menu you get by holding a voice message in a chat. Saves the recording as an audio file. One sent to be played once never gets it.
column2: 在聊天中长按语音消息的菜单里新增「保存」。把录音保存为音频文件。只能播放一次的语音消息不会提供此选项。

column1: Adds Select text to a selected comment's menu, a post's details and a profile's menu. It opens the text in a window where you can select part of it and copy it. Links work there.
column2: 在评论菜单、帖子详情和个人主页菜单中加入「选择文字」。文字会在窗口中打开，你可以选取一部分复制。链接也可以点开。

column1: Adds View profile picture to the menu on someone's profile. Opens their picture full screen at the largest size Instagram has, with pinch zoom and a Save button.
